about.title: About StudyBeats
about.subtitle: Our mission, our vision, and why we exist
about.summary_text: StudyBeats is an online platform that transforms study materials into educational songs using artificial intelligence. It's designed for students at all levels — high school, university, competitive exams — who want to leverage their musical memory for more effective revision.
about.why_text1: Everyone has memorized song lyrics effortlessly. Neuroscience research shows that music activates brain areas linked to long-term memory, facilitating information encoding and recall.
about.why_text2: Yet no simple tool existed to turn study notes into songs in a few clicks. That's the problem StudyBeats solves: making musical revision accessible to every student, without any musical or technical skills.
about.mission_text: Give every student a complementary revision tool, grounded in cognitive science, that transforms any study material into a memorable musical experience. StudyBeats doesn't replace the work — it makes it more engaging and effective.
about.how_step1: Upload your notes — Paste text, import a PDF, or take a photo of your handwritten notes. The AI extracts the content automatically.
about.how_step2: Choose a music style — 8 genres available: rap, lo-fi, pop, jazz, rock, spoken-word, reggaeton, and classical.
about.how_step3: AI generates the lyrics — Educational lyrics structured around the key concepts of your notes, adapted to your chosen style.
about.how_step4: Test yourself with the quiz — A 10-question MCQ is auto-generated from your notes and lyrics.
about.value1_desc: Every feature is designed to maximize memorization. No useless gimmicks.
about.value2_desc: Education should be accessible to all. StudyBeats is free and adapted to all fields of study.
about.value3_desc: AI as a pedagogical lever, not a shortcut. The goal is to help understand and retain.
about.value4_desc: StudyBeats evolves based on user feedback and the student community.
about.contact_text: Don't hesitate to contact us for any questions, suggestions, or partnerships.

footer.description: AI-powered music revision platform. Turn your notes into songs for effective memorization.
